name: ADD Industry (Zhejiang) Co. Ltd.
summary: ADD Industry (Zhejiang) Co. Ltd. operates within China, focusing on the manufacturing and distribution of shock absorbers designed for vehicle suspension systems. The company's diverse product range encompasses standard shock absorbers, strut cartridges, complete struts, strut assemblies, steering dampers, and cabin dampers. Founded in 1994, the firm's headquarters are located in Taizhou, China.
